candidates.change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to "1.0.1".
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.1"; }

candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment `number = _number;` so the state variable `number` is never updated by setL1BlockValues.
Replace `number = _number;` with `number = _timestamp;` so `number` is set to the timestamp argument instead of the number argument.
Insert `number = 0;` into the onlyDepositor modifier so `number` is reset to zero whenever setL1BlockValues runs.
Replace the assignment `timestamp = _timestamp;` with `timestamp = _number;` so timestamp stores the block number argument instead.
Delete the assignment `timestamp = _timestamp;` so timestamp remains 0 after any call to setL1BlockValues.
Replace the assignment `timestamp = _timestamp;` with `timestamp = uint64(block.timestamp);` so timestamp stores the current block timestamp instead of the argument.

Invert the modifier check from `msg.sender == DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT` to `msg.sender != DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT`, allowing non-depositors to set values and blocking the depositor, exposing different timestamp values.
